DỊCH VỤ SIÊU TỆ / SUPER LOW SERVICE QUALITY
Apr 2026 • Friends
DỊCH VỤ SIÊU TỆ / SUPER LOW SERVICE QUALITY

I’ve worked in hospitality for many years and almost never leave bad reviews. But I HAVE TO write this one—not for the owner (because the way they respond already says everything), but for anyone considering coming here during their Da Nang trip.

We waited 30 minutes for something as simple as coconuts. We asked multiple times and were ignored. No urgency, no ownership, no basic service mindset. The staff were careless, and the young manager clearly had no idea how to handle a simple customer complaint.

But the worst part isn’t even the service—it’s the attitude. After reading the owner’s replies on Google, it’s honestly shocking how someone can run a hospitality business and speak to paying customers like that. Rude, defensive, and embarrassingly unprofessional.

In a city like Da Nang, where tourism standards are high, this level of service and attitude is completely unacceptable.

I don’t fully blame the staff. This clearly comes from poor management and lack of training. Instead of arguing with customers online, maybe focus on fixing the service—because right now, it’s nowhere near acceptable.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS if you care about equality- learn from my experience!!!!
Aug 2025 • Solo
I have been in Vietnam for the last 3 weeks and I literally arrived in Danang this evening. 

l spotted this bar which is a few minutes walk from my hotel. It reminded me of a place I went to in Greece and I had a warm welcome from Duc who showed me a seat by the bar before I moved to another seat behind the DJ who was playing really good tunes- DJ is calle Papa Mama Man. After spending a few hours here having cocktails and food I got up to use the bathroom and that’s when things went from being good to the WORST experience of my trip so far. 

 Two staff followed me to the toilet and as soon as I stepped out whilst I was washing my hands the server called Lahn showed me my bill and said I needed to pay. AT THE TOILET!!!!!!

I have travelled worldwide and never in my life have I ever been accosted outside the toilet and asked to settle my bill. I had given them no indication whatsoever that I was walking out of the joint. I asked Lahn why she had followef me to the toilet and I had NOT in my whole evening there seen them following anyone else to the toilet and asking them to pay their bill. The manager Kiem tried to explain that it was because I hadn’t left any of my possessions at the bar but as a female solo traveller I was not going to leave anything behind whilst going to the toilet because how would I know that it would be there on my return???? He said it is because I hadn’t told my server I was going to the toilet but who usually tells their server they are going to the toilet. I found their excuses pathetic and frankly very insulting. 

As the only black person in the bar at this time with the majority of their clientele being Asian, I can only imagine they assumed because of my race I was not going to pay and I said as much to them. 

I am extremely disappointed that this was my first experience in Danang. I will not be in Danang long but I will not be returning to this bar again. Any person of colour should think twice before entering this establishment.

To confirm contrary to this establishment’s prejudice: 
I paid the bill in FULL and left shortly afterwards.
